heroSub: Five beachside stays in Khlong Wan, Mueang Prachuap Khiri Khan district, that we've reviewed in depth — a whale-themed boutique with a sea-view pool, a loft-style beachfront resort, a leafy garden resort near Ao Manao, Moroccan design where every room opens onto the sea, and a quiet, budget-friendly home resort. Prices start at about ฿590–1,900/night.
introH2: 🌊 What kinds of beachside stays does Khlong Wan have, and how do you pick the right one?
introHtml: Khlong Wan is a small fishing village about 10–15 minutes' drive south of Prachuap Khiri Khan town, where people in the know come to escape the bustle of Hua Hin and chill by the sea — and the beachside stays here come in more shapes than you'd expect · Some are whale-themed boutiques with a sea-view pool and Sea View rooms with a jacuzzi; some are loft-style beachfront resorts where you step from your room straight onto the sand; some are leafy garden resorts near Ao Manao; some are white Moroccan-design places where every room's balcony faces the sea; and some are quiet home resorts where you wake up, hop on a bike and pedal off for seafood · Khlong Wan's appeal is its calm and the feel of a seaside town that tourism hasn't swallowed yet — the trade-off is that almost everywhere needs your own car, and the sea at many spots is more about the view than a white-sand beach for swimming · This article rounds up 5 Khlong Wan beachside stays we've reviewed in depth, from a 4-star boutique to a home resort in the hundreds of baht — every one drawn from reading real guest reviews, telling you both the good and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites, with direct booking links for all.
mrtHtml: Khlong Wan has no convenient public transport, so nearly every stay in this area needs your own car or a rented car/motorbike · It's about 10–15 minutes' drive south of Prachuap town · The nearest train station is Nong Hin Station, about 1.7–2.2 km from the stays in this area (you'll need onward transport) · The main attractions this area sits close to: King Mongkut Memorial Park of Science and Technology at Waghor and the Waghor Aquarium — great for kids, a short drive from everywhere · Ao Manao, inside the Wing 5 air base, has a nicer beach than the village front, about 5–15 minutes' drive · Prachuap town, Khao Chong Krachok, the markets and seafood restaurants are about 10–25 minutes' drive up · The local treat is fresh seafood from the Khlong Wan fishing pier at village prices.

entries.name: @T Boutique Hotel
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Wan seafront · 10 min to Waghor

rooms.type: Deluxe Sea View (some rooms have a jacuzzi)

tags: 🛁 Sea View rooms, some with a jacuzzi
entries.addr: 582 Moo 1, Khlong Wan subdistrict, Mueang Prachuap Khiri Khan district
entries.storyHtml: Among the 5 Khlong Wan beachside stays, if you measure by review count and name recognition, @T Boutique Hotel is the most-reviewed in this article — over 1,000 reviews across several platforms, an average score around 8.4, and a place among the top hotels in the province · It's a 4-star boutique hotel of about 92 rooms, open since 2015, facing the Khlong Wan bay in the fishing village, about 15 minutes south of Prachuap town · What people remember it for is the blue whale-themed design (a nod to the name "Khlong Wan," wan meaning whale), with photo corners throughout and a cute Bryde's Whale cafe · What reviews mention most is the outdoor sea-view pool, which many call clean with a great atmosphere, good for both swimming and photos, paired with spacious rooms with balconies, and Sea View rooms — some with a jacuzzi to soak in while taking in the view, a highlight many couples come specifically for · There's a seaside restaurant, @T Terrace, that reviews praise for its Thai food and dinner atmosphere, and it's only about 10 minutes from the Waghor science park, good for families · Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a 2015 building, so some rooms are starting to show their age with worn furniture in places, food quality is inconsistent at some meals, and the sea in front of the hotel is about the view, not a white-sand beach for swimming · Importantly, a fishing-village location like this all but requires your own car, since there are no shops within walking distance · In short, it's great value at the standard-room rate around two thousand baht, and a solid pick for couples and families who want a quiet seaside atmosphere with design that has some character.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if the sea view and jacuzzi are the main draw, specify a Deluxe Sea View or Sea View Suite clearly, because a standard Deluxe room may not have a full sea view · And before paying for a pricey sea-view room, read the latest reviews and check updated photos, since this is a 2015 building where room condition can vary.
pros: Most reviewed in this article, over 1,000 reviews · average score around 8.4
Sea-view pool, the thing reviews praise most for looks and cleanliness
Spacious rooms with balconies · Sea View rooms, some with a jacuzzi couples love
Whale-themed design with character · 10 min to Waghor, good for families
cons: 2015 building, some rooms starting to age with worn furniture
Sea in front is about the view, not a white-sand swimming beach · food inconsistent at some meals
Fishing-village location, all but requires your own car (from reviews)

entries.type: Beachfront Resort 4★ · right on the beach
entries.name: Lipda Resort
entries.badge: 🏖️ Truly on the beach, step from room to sand
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Wan beach · 1.5 km to Waghor Aquarium
entries.addr: 456/1 Moo 1, Khlong Wan subdistrict, Mueang Prachuap Khiri Khan district
entries.storyHtml: In this group, if "truly on the beach" is what you're after, Lipda Resort is the clearest match — a 4-star beachfront resort on Khlong Wan beach where you step from your room straight onto the sand, and a beach that's very quiet and private, since this area isn't as crowded as Hua Hin or the in-town Prachuap bay · The selling point the positive reviews agree on is waking up early, opening the door to white sand and a calm sea with almost no one around, watching the sunrise from your balcony with a hot coffee, paired with a big pool reviews call spacious with a good atmosphere, plus high-ceilinged loft-style rooms and jacuzzi rooms for those who want to soak and relax · It's about 1.5 km from the Waghor Aquarium and the King Mongkut science park, good for kids · But to be straight: of these 5, Lipda is where the reviews split most clearly into two camps, so the overall score sits around 7.0 · The caveats raised most are a location far from town, about 10–12 km, with no restaurants or convenience stores within walking distance and no public transport, so you need your own car, plus inconsistent upkeep in some rooms — sagging ceilings, doors that don't close fully, showers that splash, some rooms small with hard beds — along with a breakfast with fairly limited options, and some guests feeling the price is high for the condition · The honest verdict: if you're here for a quiet beach and a big pool, you have your own car, you choose a room in good shape, and you set expectations around the atmosphere, this place delivers a private beachfront experience at an affordable price — but if you expect a flawless luxury resort in every corner, weigh it carefully and read the latest reviews before booking.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: because upkeep varies room to room, if you're paying the higher jacuzzi-loft rate, ask to see the latest room photos and confirm the room is in good, ready-to-stay condition before you commit · And bring snacks and food in the car from town, because there's very little to eat around the resort.
pros: Truly on the beach, step from room to sand, Khlong Wan beach is quiet and private
Lovely seaside sunrise view · big pool with a good atmosphere
Loft-style rooms and jacuzzi rooms give a restful feel
1.5 km to Waghor Aquarium · friendly, attentive staff
cons: Reviews are split, overall score around 7.0 · choose your room and set expectations carefully
Upkeep inconsistent in some rooms, some small with hard beds (from reviews)
Far from town, no shops within walking distance, no public transport, need a car

entries.name: Tri-Shawa Resort
entries.badge: 🌴 Leafy garden · 5 min to Ao Manao
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Wan seafront · 5 min to Ao Manao
tags: 🍹 Sky bar over the Gulf of Thailand
entries.addr: 332 Moo 1, Khlong Wan subdistrict, Mueang Prachuap Khiri Khan district
entries.storyHtml: Tri-Shawa Resort is a small boutique resort of just 27 rooms among these 5 stays, and the one that best sells the feel of a "garden resort by the sea" — open since 2012, with a major renovation in 2021, in the Khlong Wan fishing village, averaging around 8.0 from over 203 reviews · The main selling point reviews agree on is the quiet, the privacy, and the leafy greenery throughout the resort, which many say is an atmosphere that recharges you well in the evening · The highlights are an outdoor garden pool and a sky bar looking out over the Gulf of Thailand, good for a drink at sunset, paired with rooms reviews praise as clean with very good water pressure, plus bikes to borrow for pedaling around the village · The location's edge is that it's only about a 5-minute drive from Ao Manao, a pretty sandy beach inside the Wing 5 air base that many people come to Prachuap to stroll and watch the seaside monkeys, and about 10 minutes from town · The thing to be clearest about before booking: the beach in front of the resort is the fishing village's mudflat, not for swimming, with some floating debris on some days — this place's charm is the garden and the calm, not the beach out front; if you want to swim, drive to Ao Manao · Other caveats from the reviews: the beds are fairly firm for some, minibar prices and some service charges run high, parking is limited when it's busy, and there can be construction or event noise at times · In short, it's best for couples and families who want to escape for a quiet rest in a leafy garden by the sea, with their own car, and who understand from the start that they're here for the atmosphere, not the sand.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you want a sea view, ask for an Ocean View room when you book, because some garden rooms look out on trees more than the sea · If you're sensitive to a firm bed, ask ahead or be prepared, and buy water and snacks to bring in the car, since shops are hard to find around the resort and the minibar is pricey.
pros: Quiet, calm, leafy garden by the sea, a small 27-room resort that feels private
Garden pool and a sky bar with a lovely Gulf of Thailand view in the evening
Clean rooms, good water pressure · bikes to borrow, friendly staff
5 min to Ao Manao's pretty sandy beach and about 10 min to town
cons: Beach out front is a mudflat, not for swimming, go to Ao Manao instead
Beds fairly firm · minibar prices and some service charges run high (from reviews)
Need your own car, no shops around the resort · parking limited when busy

entries.name: Pearl By The Sea Resort
entries.badge: 🕌 Moroccan design · every room a sea view
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Wan beachfront · 2–3 km to Waghor
entries.addr: 556 Moo 1, Khlong Wan-Waghor Road, Khlong Wan subdistrict, Mueang Prachuap Khiri Khan district
entries.storyHtml: Among these 5 stays, if you measure by "good-looking and photogenic," Pearl By The Sea Resort is the one reviews mention most on this front — a small 3-star beachfront resort of about 20 rooms on Khlong Wan-Waghor Road that stops people in their tracks with its white Moroccan-style architecture, the rounded archways and smooth white walls that photograph well from every angle, so much that some reviews call it "the prettiest resort I've ever stayed at" · Real review score around 8.2/10 and Google 4.2/5 from 164 reviews · The clear selling point is that every room has a balcony and a sea view (some reviews call it a 180-degree wraparound sea view), paired with an outdoor pool facing the sea and a small private beach in front of the resort that's very quiet, since hardly any outsiders use it · Rooms earn praise for cleanliness, comfortable beds and soft pillows, especially the spacious bungalows, plus free breakfast, free parking, a 24-hour counter with shuttle service · Wake up early and you also catch the sunrise over Prachuap bay as a bonus · Honest caveats reviews agree on: Wi-Fi is slow and weak (some reviews say under 1 Mbps), not for people who need to work online; the location is fairly remote, town is about 15 km away, there are very few restaurants within walking distance so you should have a car; rooms have few power outlets; and TV reception is poor in some rooms · In short, it's great value at this price for couples and small families who want a pretty, peaceful private beachfront resort, with their own car, and ready to bring a power strip and mobile data of their own.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: rooms have few outlets and Wi-Fi is slow, so if you're charging several devices or need to work online, bring your own power strip and mobile data · And if you're a light sleeper, avoid rooms right next to the pool, since pool noise can carry into the room at times.
pros: Pretty white Moroccan design, photographs well from every angle, rare in Prachuap
Every room a sea-view balcony · pool facing the sea + private beach
Very clean rooms, comfortable beds and soft pillows · free breakfast, free parking
Quiet and private · lovely sunrise over Prachuap bay
cons: Wi-Fi/internet slow and weak, not for working online
Remote location, few restaurants around, should have a car
Few power outlets in rooms · poor TV reception in some rooms (from reviews)

entries.name: Kallapangha Resort
entries.badge: 💛 Best value · starts in the hundreds
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Khlong Wan-Waghor Road · walk to Khlong Wan beach
entries.addr: 284/10 Moo 1, Khlong Wan-Waghor Road, Khlong Wan subdistrict, Mueang Prachuap Khiri Khan district
entries.storyHtml: If the other beachside stays in this article sell design and a sea-view pool, Kallapangha Resort sells something else — quiet, the warmth of "staying at a relative's place by the sea," and the lightest price in the group, starting at just ฿590/night · It's a small tropical-style home resort of about 18 rooms in several styles on Khlong Wan-Waghor Road, within walking distance of Khlong Wan beach, averaging around 8.4 and TripAdvisor 4.5/5 · What guests mention most, and what lifts the overall score, is the warm, owner-run care — staff who are lovely and polite, who suggest places to go and the best seafood spots, and arrange motorbike and bike rentals, with one review recounting staff going out to find enough helmets · Rooms are decorated tropical-style, which reviews praise as clean, cute, and with plenty of outlets for convenience · What people love is the Whalecome Cafe on site to sip coffee in the sea breeze, and free bikes to pedal to the fishing pier for fresh seafood at village prices, plus free parking, and it's close to Waghor, Ao Manao, and Khao Lom Muak · Honest caveats to know before booking: it's not on the beach — the resort sits off across the road, so you walk or bike out to the seafront a bit, and most rooms don't have a direct sea view; there's no pool; some furniture looks a touch older than the price suggests; some bathrooms have low ceilings, which taller guests may find uncomfortable; and some packages don't include breakfast · In short, among the 5 Khlong Wan beachside stays we reviewed, Kallapangha is the most accessible on price and the best value, best for the quiet, value-minded traveler with their own car who wants to stay in an authentically Thai seaside fishing village with warm care on a budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: if you want atmosphere and good light, ask for a "front-zone/sea-view room" when you book, don't leave it to chance with an inner-zone room · Check the breakfast terms clearly, since some packages include it and some don't · And make the most of the free bikes — pedal to the Khlong Wan fishing pier for fresh seafood to eat.
pros: Most accessible and best-value starting price in the group, from about ฿590/night
Warm, easygoing owner and staff who help with full travel tips
Clean rooms, cute tropical decor, plenty of power outlets
Whalecome Cafe · free bikes · free parking · near fresh seafood at village prices
cons: Not on the beach, most rooms have no direct sea view · no pool
Some furniture looks a touch older than the price, some bathrooms have low ceilings
Some packages exclude breakfast · awkward to reach by train, best with your own car

faqTitle: FAQ — common questions travelers ask about Khlong Wan beach stays in Prachuap

faq.q: ❓ Which Khlong Wan beachside stay is the best?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style · if you want a sea-view pool and design with character, @T Boutique Hotel, score 8.4, most reviewed at over 1,000, whale theme, Sea View rooms some with a jacuzzi · if you want to be truly on the beach, step from room to sand, Lipda Resort has a private beach and a big pool (but reviews are split, so read the latest reviews) · if you want a quiet rest in a leafy garden, Tri-Shawa Resort · if you want a pretty, photogenic resort with every room a sea view, Pearl By The Sea · and if you're on the lightest budget and want warm, owner-run care, Kallapangha Resort starts at just ฿590

faq.q: ❓ How much do Khlong Wan beach stays cost?
faq.a: In this article prices start at about ฿590–1,900 per night for standard rooms · the most accessible are Kallapangha from ฿590 and Pearl By The Sea from ฿1,290 · the mid range is @T Boutique from ฿1,450, Lipda from ฿1,700, and Tri-Shawa from ฿1,900 · sea-view and jacuzzi rooms at some places (such as @T Boutique Sea View) climb into the several thousands · all prices are approximate starting rates, and long weekends and festivals may run higher than usual

faq.q: ❓ Do you need your own car to stay in Khlong Wan?
faq.a: You all but need one · Khlong Wan is a fishing village about 10–15 km from Prachuap town, most stays have no restaurant or convenience store within walking distance, and there's no convenient public transport · if you don't have a car, rent a car/motorbike, or ask your stay about shuttle service ahead of time · Kallapangha has free bikes and motorbike rental, and many places have free parking for those who drive themselves

faq.q: ❓ Can you swim at the sea in front of the Khlong Wan stays?
faq.a: It depends on the place · Lipda Resort is on Khlong Wan beach where you step from your room to the sand and the sea is fairly calm · but many places like @T Boutique and Tri-Shawa have a sea out front that's about the view and atmosphere (Tri-Shawa is the fishing village's mudflat), not a white-sand beach for full swimming · if you want to swim at a pretty sandy beach, drive to Ao Manao inside the Wing 5 air base, about 5–15 minutes away, and use the resort's pool instead

faq.q: ❓ Which Khlong Wan stay is good for families and kids?
faq.a: The Khlong Wan area is great for families because it's near the King Mongkut Memorial Park of Science and Technology at Waghor and the Waghor Aquarium, which kids love · Lipda Resort is 1.5 km from the aquarium with a big pool · @T Boutique Hotel is 10 min to Waghor with a sea-view pool and a kids' club · and Kallapangha has a Family room of about 70 sq m and free bikes to pedal around the village, good for families on a budget

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should you book a Khlong Wan stay?
faq.a: Most stays in this area are small (some around 18–27 rooms), so they fill fast on holidays · for long weekends and festivals, book 3–4 weeks ahead or more, especially Tri-Shawa, Kallapangha, and Pearl By The Sea, which have few rooms · for ordinary weekdays, booking 1–2 weeks ahead is enough · every platform usually offers Free Cancellation, so lock in a rate like that if your plans aren't firm, then compare Agoda / Booking / Trip.com for the best price, and read the latest reviews before booking any higher-priced room
